item.title: Free Addition to 5 Worksheets: 3 Printable Pages
item.description: Free printable Addition to 5 worksheets to try with your child. Download 3 sample pages and print them at home or in class, in full color or in ink-saving black and white, US Letter or A4. No sign-up needed. The full pack has 24 pages.

item.title: Addition within 5 Worksheets for Preschool and Kindergarten (Printable, No Prep)
item.description: Printable addition within 5 worksheets for preschool and kindergarten. Ten picture pages to count, then ten pages of problems with a number line to help, plus an answer key. No prep, print and go. Comes in color and in black and white to save ink.

item.title: Number Line Addition Practice to 10: No Prep Printable Worksheets
item.description: No prep addition practice for beginners. Children start with picture problems and move on to adding with a number line from 0 to 10. 160 problems in total, with an answer key so a child can check their own work. For kindergarten, first grade and homeschool math.
